title: will/shall (1)
summary: **will + глагол** — для прогнозов и общих утверждений о будущем (**It will be sunny tomorrow**); **shall** с I и we.
ru:
## Что такое will
**will** — модальный глагол, который показывает будущее. После него — глагол в начальной форме (без to).
> Tomorrow she **will be** in Rome. — Завтра она будет в Риме.
> The birds **will eat** the bread. — Птицы склюют хлеб.
> You **won't sleep** if you drink coffee at night. — Ты не уснёшь, если выпьешь кофе ночью.

## Краткие формы
- **'ll** = will: I'll, you'll, she'll, we'll, they'll
- **won't** = will not: I won't, he won't
> I'll be at home this evening. — Вечером я буду дома.
> I **won't** be here tomorrow. — Завтра меня здесь не будет.

## Когда используем will
Для прогноза, предположения, обещания о будущем — особенно когда мы **не планировали это заранее**.
> Sue is in Madrid today. Tomorrow she'**ll be** in Rome. — Сегодня Сью в Мадриде, завтра будет в Риме.
> We'll **probably** go out tonight. — Мы, скорее всего, пойдём гулять вечером.
> **Will** you be at home this evening? — Ты вечером будешь дома?

## I think ... will
Часто говорим «я думаю, что ...».
> I **think** Diana **will pass** the exam. — Думаю, Диана сдаст экзамен.
> I **don't think** it **will rain** this afternoon. — Не думаю, что днём пойдёт дождь. (отрицание — в первой части!)
> Do you think the exam **will be** difficult? — Как думаешь, экзамен будет сложным?

## Когда НЕ will
Если мы уже **договорились или решили** (юниты 26–27), будем использовать другие конструкции.
> We **are going** to the cinema on Saturday. (не We will go)
> I'm **not working** tomorrow. (не I won't work)
> **Are** you **going to** do the exam? (не Will you do)

## shall
С **I** и **we** иногда используют **shall** (чуть формально): I shall be late. = I'll be late. С he / she / they / you shall **не** говорим.
- ~~Tom shall be late.~~ → Tom **will** be late.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She will comes.~~ → She will **come**.
- ~~I will to go.~~ → I will **go**. (без to)
- ~~I don't think it will not rain.~~ → I **don't think** it will rain.
en:
## What is will?
**will** is a modal verb for the future. After **will** we use the infinitive (without to).
> Tomorrow she **will be** in Rome.
> The birds **will eat** the bread.
> You **won't sleep** if you drink coffee at night.

## Short forms
- **'ll** = will: I'll, you'll, she'll, we'll, they'll
- **won't** = will not: I won't, he won't
> I'll be at home this evening.
> I **won't** be here tomorrow.

## When we use will
For predictions and general statements about the future, especially when we haven't planned something.
> Sue is in Madrid today. Tomorrow she'**ll be** in Rome.
> We'll **probably** go out tonight.
> **Will** you be at home this evening?

## I think ... will
> I **think** Diana **will pass** the exam.
> I **don't think** it **will rain** this afternoon.
> Do you think the exam **will be** difficult?

## When we do NOT use will
For things we have already arranged or decided (Units 26–27).
> We **are going** to the cinema on Saturday. (not We will go)
> I'm **not working** tomorrow. (not I won't work)
> **Are** you **going to** do the exam? (not Will you do)

## shall
With **I** and **we** we can say **shall** (= will): I shall be late. We do **not** use shall with you / they / he / she / it.
- ~~Tom shall be late.~~ → Tom **will** be late.

## Common mistakes
- ~~She will comes.~~ → She will **come**.
- ~~I will to go.~~ → I will **go**.
- ~~I don't think it will not rain.~~ → I **don't think** it will rain.
structure:
## Формы
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| I will (I'll) come. | I will not (won't) come. | Will I come? |
| He will (he'll) come. | He won't come. | Will he come? |
| We will (we'll) come. | We won't come. | Will we come? |

## Краткие ответы
- Will you be late? — Yes, I **will**. / No, I **won't**.
- Will she come? — Yes, she **will**. / No, she **won't**.

## Слова, с которыми часто идёт will
- probably (стоит между will и глаголом: **will probably go**)
- I think ... will / I don't think ... will
- tomorrow, next week, next year, soon

## Формулы
> подлежащее + **will / 'll / won't** + глагол (без to)
> **Will** + подлежащее + глагол ... ?
> I / we + **shall** (= will, формально)

## will и другие конструкции
| Ситуация | Что использовать |
|---|---|
| уже договорились | present continuous: I'm meeting Tom tomorrow. |
| уже решили, намерение | going to: I'm going to learn English. |
| прогноз, мысль о будущем | will: It will be sunny. |

exercises.title: Вчера, сегодня, завтра
exercises.example: Yesterday Helen was in Paris. Today she's in Rome. Tomorrow she'll be in London.

items.text: Yesterday I {{was}} at work. Today I'm at home. Tomorrow I {{will be|'ll be}} at the gym.
Last night they {{were}} at a restaurant.
It's cold today. I think tomorrow it {{will be|'ll be}} colder.
My sister is in Italy now. Next month she {{will be|'ll be}} in Spain.
Yesterday it {{was}} sunny. Today it {{is|'s}} rainy.
I {{won't be|will not be}} here tomorrow. I'm on holiday.
Don't drink coffee now. You {{won't|will not}} sleep tonight.
Leave the bread in the garden. The birds {{will}} eat it.
I think Anna {{will|'ll}} pass the exam. She works hard.
It's very cold. I think it {{will|'ll}} snow tomorrow.
Don't worry. I {{won't|will not}} tell anybody.

items.why: Отрицание ставим в первую часть: **I don't think ... will**.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Сделайте прогнозы с **will / won't / I think**.

items.sample: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.

items.prompt: Где вы будете завтра в 10 утра?
items.sample: I'll be at work tomorrow at 10 a.m.

items.prompt: Что вы, скорее всего, будете делать вечером?
items.sample: I'll probably watch a film at home.

items.prompt: Какой ваш прогноз на следующий год?
items.sample: I think I will learn a lot of new words next year.

items.prompt: Что вы НЕ будете делать завтра?
items.sample: I won't get up early tomorrow.
